messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — sampleapp rerank test failing on staging. Node SDK returns embeddings under `vector` while Python returns `embedding`. Causing downstream shape checks to blow up.

 tj: ah. do we have an example payload? paste?

 maya: pasted below
```
# Node SDK response (truncated)
{"id":"q1","vector":[0.12, -0.03, ...], "score":0.93}
# Python response
{"id":"q1","embedding":[0.12, -0.03, ...], "score":0.93}
```

 kevin: omg. that's the field rename we missed during the v2 SDK launch. Node kept `vector` for legacy reasons.

 sara: this also breaks the batching helper when retrying — it uses position index from the original request and then reorder occurs => wrong vector matched to queries.

 maya: repro steps:
 1) send batch of 3
 2) transient auth refresh causes 2nd request to be retried
 3) batch helper dedup reorders -> final map wrong

 maya: stack trace snippet:
```
BatchHelper.prototype._applyRetries
  at Object.reorder (/src/batcher/index.js:142:22)
  at retrySend (/src/batcher/index.js:88:12)
```

 tj: is this only Node? go/rust SDKs?

 kevin: go seems to follow Python naming `embedding`. rust-client maps to `emb`. ugh

 sara: proposed short-term patch: sampleapp normalize both `vector` and `embedding` to `embedding` in devex helper. Longer-term: align SDKs and add response schema e2e tests.

 maya: I'll open a PR to sampleapp. Also adding a unit test for batcher reorder when retries happen.

 tj: thanks. ping @devex-bot to create an issue and add to sprint.

 devex-bot: Created issue #DEVEX-441: "SDK parity: embedding field mismatch & batcher retry reorder" and added to sprint "devex-sprint-14" :white_check_mark:

 kevin: one more note — embedding dims can be different (384 vs 1536). add assert with helpful error message instead of silent truncation.

 maya: noted. will add shape-checking error with sample payload. thanks!

 sara: can someone add a tiny integration test hitting hosted API? just to catch field-name regressions.

 tj: I'll add a post-merge test in CI that validates both field names accepted and canonicalized.

 maya: cool. I'll attach PR link once ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/62

 sara: :thumbsup:
